english: Then this is your shift: today’s chair, your next customer, and how your week is going. We remember your choice.
translation: Zatim ovde vidiš svoju smenu: današnju stolicu, sledećeg klijenta i kako ti ide nedelja. Pamtimo tvoj izbor.

english: Holiday, sick days and contract hours are managed by the shop under
translation: Godišnji odmor, bolovanja i ugovorene sate uređuje salon pod

english: Deposits, card or pay-at-salon, weekly payouts.
translation: Depoziti, kartica ili plaćanje u salonu, isplate svake nedelje.

english: Pay online or at the salon. Reminders and directions included.
translation: Plati onlajn ili u salonu. Podsetnici i uputstva za put uključeni.

english: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay — or simply pay at the salon.
translation: Kartica, Apple Pay, Google Pay — ili jednostavno u salonu.

english: Patch tests, consent and allergy notes handled before you arrive.
translation: Probe na alergije, saglasnost i beleške o alergijama rešeni su pre tvog dolaska.

english: Calendar, payments, team rota, stock and loyalty — one app, no setup fee.
translation: Kalendar, plaćanja, raspored tima, zalihe i lojalnost — jedna aplikacija, bez troškova uvođenja.

english: Uses your taste profile (consent — GDPR Art. 22 explainable)
translation: Koristi tvoj profil ukusa (uz saglasnost — objašnjivo prema čl. 22 GDPR)

english: Rest is paid at the shop
This card number does not check out — please re-check it.
translation: Ovaj broj kartice nije ispravan — proveri ga ponovo.

english: By confirming you authorize StyleNow Demo to collect this amount by SEPA direct debit (demo mandate).
translation: Potvrdom ovlašćuješ StyleNow Demo da naplati ovaj iznos SEPA direktnim zaduženjem (demo ovlašćenje).

english: Demo checkout — no real charge is made and nothing you type leaves your browser. Only a masked label like “Visa ····4242” is kept.
translation: Demo naplata — ništa se ne naplaćuje i ništa što upišeš ne napušta tvoj pregledač. Čuva se samo maskirana oznaka poput „Visa ····4242”.

english: Your whole configuration — team, hours, menu, rules, photos, billing, customer notes — as one JSON file you own. Download it before big changes; restore it if anything goes wrong.
translation: Cela tvoja konfiguracija — tim, radno vreme, ponuda, pravila, fotografije, naplata, beleške o klijentima — kao jedna JSON datoteka koja je tvoja. Preuzmi je pre velikih izmena; vrati je ako nešto krene naopako.

english: Tap an appointment to reschedule it, message the customer, or settle it.
translation: Dodirni termin da ga pomeriš, pošalješ poruku klijentu ili ga naplatiš.

english: Pick a range — the chart shows the trend, the panels split it by service, team member and payment method.
translation: Izaberi period — grafikon pokazuje trend, a paneli ga dele po usluzi, članu tima i načinu plaćanja.

english: Gift cards sold show their outstanding balance — money received for work not yet delivered.
translation: Prodate poklon kartice prikazuju neiskorišćeno stanje — novac primljen za posao koji još nije obavljen.

english: The note field is yours alone — customers never see it.
translation: Polje za belešku je samo tvoje — klijenti ga nikad ne vide.

english: Open a row to jump straight into that customer’s message thread.
translation: Otvori red da pređeš pravo na razgovor sa tim klijentom.

english: Every customer conversation for this shop, in one place.
translation: Svaki razgovor sa klijentima za ovaj salon, na jednom mestu.

english: “Can I move my appointment?” usually answers itself — customers can move bookings from their side.
translation: „Mogu li da pomerim termin?” se obično reši samo od sebe — klijenti mogu sami da pomeraju rezervacije.

english: Roles, branches and weekly hours — the roster here is exactly what customers can book.
translation: Uloge, filijale i nedeljno radno vreme — raspored ovde je tačno ono što klijenti mogu da zakažu.

english: Removing someone who still has booked customers opens a resolver first — nobody gets stranded.
translation: Uklanjanje nekoga ko još ima zakazane klijente prvo otvara alat za rešavanje — niko ne ostaje na cedilu.

english: Approving leave lists every booked visit inside it, each one a tap to reassign or refund.
translation: Odobravanje odsustva navodi svaku zakazanu posetu u tom periodu, a svaka je na jedan dodir od preraspodele ili povraćaja novca.

english: Billing details feed every receipt and e-invoice the shop issues.
translation: Podaci za naplatu idu na svaki račun i e-račun koji salon izdaje.

english: Redeem at checkout — enter the code in the voucher field
translation: Iskoristi pri plaćanju — unesi kod u polje za vaučer

english: Redeem it at checkout on StyleNow — enter the code in the voucher field when booking at {shop}.
translation: Iskoristi je pri plaćanju na StyleNow — unesi kod u polje za vaučer prilikom rezervacije u salonu {shop}.

english: This gift card has been fully used.
translation: Ova poklon kartica je potpuno iskorišćena.

english: Bought on this device. The recipient just needs the code — it works in the voucher field at checkout.
translation: Kupljeno na ovom uređaju. Primaocu treba samo kod — radi u polju za vaučer pri plaćanju.

english: A gift card in two minutes — printable, mailable, redeemable at checkout.
translation: Poklon kartica za dva minuta — može se odštampati, poslati mejlom i iskoristiti pri plaćanju.

english: Outstanding balances are money received for services not yet delivered — a liability until redeemed.
translation: Neiskorišćena stanja su novac primljen za usluge koje još nisu obavljene — obaveza dok se ne iskoriste.

english: {have} of {need} stamps — a full card makes the next visit free
translation: {have} od {need} pečata — puna kartica donosi sledeću posetu besplatno
Kartica sa pečatima: svaka {n}. poseta besplatna
Kartica sa pečatima (svaka N-ta poseta besplatna)

english: Your loyalty program, funded by you: {n} completed visits within six months and the next one is free. Stamps and rewards are counted from real bookings — nothing to stamp by hand, nothing to forge.
translation: Tvoj program lojalnosti, koji ti finansiraš: {n} obavljenih poseta u šest meseci i sledeća je besplatna. Pečati i nagrade računaju se iz stvarnih rezervacija — ništa se ne pečatira ručno, ništa se ne može falsifikovati.

english: A discount that only applies in your two emptiest day-parts of the last 30 days. Those times carry a badge, so customers see why they’re cheaper.
translation: Popust koji važi samo u tvoja dva najpraznija dela dana u poslednjih 30 dana. Ti termini nose oznaku, pa klijenti vide zašto su jeftiniji.
{shop} ti je poslao vaučer izvinjenja od 5 €

english: Your data lives in this browser. Take it with you, or blank the personal parts in place.
translation: Tvoji podaci žive u ovom pregledaču. Ponesi ih sa sobom ili izbriši lične delove na licu mesta.

english: Blanks your name, phone, notes, memos and message texts everywhere. Amounts and dates stay, so the salons’ books still add up. Cannot be undone.
translation: Briše tvoje ime, telefon, beleške, podsetnike i tekstove poruka svuda. Iznosi i datumi ostaju, pa knjige salona i dalje štimaju. Ne može se poništiti.
nema otkazivanja od strane salona u 90 dana

english: {n}× cancelled, {m}× moved late by the salon (90 days)
translation: {n}× otkazano, {m}× kasno pomereno od strane salona (90 dana)

english: Late cancel or move by the salon? A €5 sorry-voucher is issued automatically.
translation: Salon kasno otkazuje ili pomera? Vaučer izvinjenja od 5 € izdaje se automatski.

english: What the next shift must know…
translation: Šta sledeća smena mora da zna…

english: Completed service revenue per stylist × their percent (set in the team editor). Tips are listed, never commissioned.
translation: Prihod od obavljenih usluga po frizeru × njegov procenat (podešava se u uređivaču tima). Bakšiši su navedeni, ali se ne provizionišu.

english: This service involves colour chemistry and I have no recent patch test here. I understand the salon may do a quick test first or decline the treatment.
translation: Ova usluga uključuje hemiju boje, a ovde nemam skoriju probu na alergiju. Razumem da salon može prvo da uradi brzu probu ili da odbije tretman.

english: Patch test was done — remember it
translation: Proba na alergiju je urađena — zapamti

english: Patch test recorded for this salon (valid 6 months)
translation: Proba na alergiju zabeležena za ovaj salon (važi 6 meseci)
Očekuje se proba na alergiju — usluga sa bojom/hemijom

english: No recent patch test on record for this customer
translation: Nema skorije probe na alergiju u evidenciji ovog klijenta

english: N visits of one service for a bundle price, paid up front. Uses are counted from real bookings — a card cannot be over-spent, and a cancellation returns the use automatically.
translation: N poseta jedne usluge po paket ceni, plaćeno unapred. Korišćenja se broje iz stvarnih rezervacija — kartica se ne može prekoračiti, a otkazivanje automatski vraća korišćenje.

english: {sold} sold · {uses} visits outstanding · {eur} of prepaid work open
translation: Prodato: {sold} · neiskorišćenih poseta: {uses} · otvoreno unapred plaćenog rada: {eur}
ai_review_note: pk_liability: anglicism 'prepaid rada' replaced with 'unapred plaćenog rada'.

english: Pay once, come back on your terms.
translation: Plati jednom, dolazi kad ti odgovara.

english: Gift cards in bulk for your team or clients — one order, one invoice, a volume discount from 5 cards (5 %), 10 (10 %) or 20 (15 %). Every code redeems at full face value.
translation: Poklon kartice u većoj količini za tvoj tim ili klijente — jedna narudžbina, jedan račun, popust na količinu od 5 kartica (5 %), 10 (10 %) ili 20 (15 %). Svaki kod se koristi u punoj nominalnoj vrednosti.

english: Hand one code to each person — every code is an ordinary gift card at full face value, redeemable in the booking checkout.
translation: Daj po jedan kod svakoj osobi — svaki kod je obična poklon kartica u punoj nominalnoj vrednosti, koja se koristi pri plaćanju rezervacije.

english: The payment page could not be opened just now. Your seat is still held — try again in a moment.
translation: Stranica za plaćanje trenutno nije mogla da se otvori. Tvoje mesto je i dalje rezervisano — pokušaj ponovo za trenutak.

english: Let guests settle at the counter — card or cash — instead of paying when they book. A deposit, where one is set, is still taken online: that is what holds the seat.
translation: Dozvoli gostima da plate na kasi — karticom ili gotovinom — umesto pri rezervaciji. Depozit, ako je podešen, i dalje se uplaćuje onlajn: on drži mesto.

english: Guests may pay at the salon
translation: Gosti mogu da plate u salonu

english: When would you like to pay?
Nothing is charged now. {amount} is due at the counter — card or cash, whichever suits.
translation: Ništa se sada ne naplaćuje. {amount} se plaća na kasi — karticom ili gotovinom, kako ti odgovara.

english: Signed before the seat is held, for colour and needle work. Leave empty to ask for nothing. The wording is stored with the booking exactly as it stood when it was signed.
translation: Potpisuje se pre rezervisanja mesta, za farbanje i rad iglom. Ostavi prazno ako ne tražiš ništa. Tekst se čuva uz rezervaciju tačno onako kako je glasio kad je potpisan.

english: I confirm I have no known allergy to the products named, and that I understand the result depends on my hair’s condition…
translation: Potvrđujem da nemam poznatu alergiju na navedene proizvode i da razumem da rezultat zavisi od stanja moje kose…
Pre nego što zadržimo ovo mesto

english: Type your full name to sign
The last 90 days, from the reason people gave at the cancel. One is an anecdote; a pattern is a roster decision.
translation: Poslednjih 90 dana, prema razlogu koji su ljudi naveli pri otkazivanju. Jedan slučaj je anegdota; obrazac je odluka o rasporedu.

english: Customer announced they are about {n} min late
translation: Klijent je najavio kašnjenje od oko {n} min

english: Withdrawn — the salon expects you on time.
translation: Povučeno — salon te očekuje na vreme.

english: Could not tell the salon — the thread is the reliable door.
translation: Nije moglo da se javi salonu — poruka je pouzdan put.

english: Custom work has no fixed menu price. Describe what you have in mind and the answer lands in your messages — no booking needed first.
translation: Posao po meri nema fiksnu cenu u ponudi. Opiši šta imaš na umu i odgovor stiže u tvoje poruke — nije potrebna prethodna rezervacija.

english: A flat monthly fee for a standing discount on every visit. Recurring revenue for you, a reason to stop shopping around for them. (Demo: the fee is simulated, no money moves.)
translation: Fiksna mesečna naknada za stalni popust na svaku posetu. Ponavljajući prihod za tebe, razlog da klijenti prestanu da traže drugde. (Demo: naknada je simulirana, novac se ne kreće.)

english: Travels with this device, fills itself into every booking, and disappears with “erase my data”.
translation: Putuje sa ovim uređajem, sam se unosi u svaku rezervaciju i nestaje uz „obriši moje podatke”.

english: Only promise what the premises actually have — customers plan their trip around this.
translation: Obećaj samo ono što prostor zaista ima — klijenti prema tome planiraju put.

english: Customers who saved their birthday get this discount automatically in the two weeks around it — a guaranteed annual visit occasion.
translation: Klijenti koji su sačuvali rođendan automatski dobijaju ovaj popust u dve nedelje oko njega — zagarantovan godišnji povod za posetu.

english: Colour service: first colour visit here? A patch test 48 h ahead is recommended — just message the salon.
translation: Usluga farbanja: prvi put ovde? Preporučuje se proba na alergiju 48 h ranije — samo pošalji poruku salonu.

english: Sell a gift card at the counter
Gift card created — hand over the code
Share your code. Your friend gets €5 off their first booking over €25 — and the moment it confirms, a €5 gift card lands on your account.
translation: Podeli svoj kod. Tvoj prijatelj dobija 5 € popusta na prvu rezervaciju preko 25 € — a čim se potvrdi, poklon kartica od 5 € stiže na tvoj nalog.

english: This treatment needs a signed consent, and there is only one consent field for the whole party — book each chair separately instead.
translation: Ovaj tretman zahteva potpisanu saglasnost, a postoji samo jedno polje za saglasnost za celu grupu — zakaži svaku stolicu posebno.

english: The day’s money in one printable sheet — revenue, VAT, tips, fees, refunds, and the split by payment method. Derived live from the calendar, so it can never disagree with it.
translation: Novac dana na jednom listu za štampu — prihod, PDV, bakšiši, naknade, povraćaji i podela po načinu plaćanja. Izvedeno uživo iz kalendara, pa se nikad ne može razlikovati od njega.

english: Derived from the day’s bookings at the moment of opening. Demo report — not a fiscal document (no TSE signature).
translation: Izvedeno iz rezervacija dana u trenutku otvaranja. Demo izveštaj — nije fiskalni dokument (bez TSE potpisa).

english: Seat reserved — finish payment to keep it.
translation: Mesto je rezervisano — završi plaćanje da ga zadržiš.

english: That time was just taken. Here are the nearest free alternatives:
translation: Taj termin je upravo zauzet. Evo najbližih slobodnih alternativa:

english: ✅ Cancelled in time — {refund} refunded in full.
translation: ✅ Otkazano na vreme — {refund} vraćeno u celosti.

ai_review_note: pk_liability: anglicism 'prepaid rada' replaced with 'unapred plaćenog rada'.

english: Surge is capped at +25 % platform-wide and never hits returning customers on repeat services.
translation: Poskupljenje je ograničeno na +25 % na celoj platformi i nikad ne pogađa stalne klijente na ponovljenim uslugama.

english: Payment is settled at the shop — the seat is blocked immediately.
translation: Plaćanje se obavlja u salonu — mesto se odmah blokira.

english: Type the name from the signed consent before booking this treatment.
translation: Upiši ime iz potpisane saglasnosti pre rezervacije ovog tretmana.

english: Tip: click a free spot to add an appointment; click a booking to open it — details, phone, move, complete or cancel.
translation: Savet: klikni na slobodno mesto da dodaš termin; klikni na rezervaciju da je otvoriš — detalji, telefon, pomeranje, završetak ili otkazivanje.

english: Shown to customers on your shop page and in search. PNG/JPG, squared works best.
translation: Prikazuje se klijentima na stranici salona i u pretrazi. PNG/JPG, najbolje kvadratni.

english: Missing a category? Add your own
Running several salons? Add each location — they appear as one chain with separate calendars.
translation: Vodiš više salona? Dodaj svaku lokaciju — pojavljuju se kao jedan lanac sa odvojenim kalendarima.

english: Demonstration project — no real payments or appointments.
translation: Demonstracioni projekat — bez stvarnih plaćanja ili termina.

english: Booked as a business? German bookkeeping systems ingest structured e-invoices (E-Rechnung). This downloads the same receipt as machine-readable XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Private customers don’t need this — the receipt above is your document either way.
translation: Zakazuješ kao firma? Nemački računovodstveni sistemi primaju strukturirane e-račune (E-Rechnung). Ovo preuzima isti račun kao mašinski čitljiv XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Privatnim klijentima ovo ne treba — račun iznad je tvoj dokument u svakom slučaju.

english: Generated from this booking’s data and validated against the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0 rules + EN 16931). Demo notice: the salon data itself is demo data.
translation: Generisano iz podataka ove rezervacije i provereno zvaničnim KoSIT validatorom (pravila XRechnung 3.0 + EN 16931). Demo napomena: podaci salona su i sami demo podaci.

english: They’re on your bookings page — each can be moved or cancelled on its own.
translation: Nalaze se na stranici tvojih rezervacija — svaka se može posebno pomeriti ili otkazati.

english: Future visits are paid at the salon, visit by visit.
translation: Buduće posete se plaćaju u salonu, posetu po posetu.

english: Tip (not part of the service price)
This receipt is issued by the salon. Keep it for expense claims — salons retain their copies for the statutory period.
translation: Ovaj račun izdaje salon. Sačuvaj ga za dokazivanje troškova — saloni čuvaju svoje primerke u zakonskom roku.

english: What your receipts say. The legal name and tax number appear on every customer receipt.
translation: Šta piše na tvojim računima. Pravni naziv i poreski broj pojavljuju se na svakom računu klijenta.

english: Small business (§ 19 UStG) — receipts show no VAT, only the exemption note
translation: Mali preduzetnik (§ 19 UStG) — računi ne prikazuju PDV, samo napomenu o oslobođenju

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: Taj termin je upravo zauzet — evo šta je još slobodno

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Ovi klijenti su već zakazani u ovom periodu. Prepusti svaku posetu slobodnom kolegi ili je otkaži uz pun povraćaj.

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Taj kolega je upravo zauzet — lista osvežena

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Salon ga otkazuje, pa klijent ne plaća ništa i dobija sve nazad.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Još nema poruka sa ovim klijentom. Pozdravi ga — kratka poruka pre termina je najjeftiniji način da se spreči nedolazak.

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: Odgovori su javni na stranici tvog salona. Budući klijenti čitaju kako se snalaziš u lošem danu bar jednako pažljivo kao i ocenu.

english: That time has just been taken
An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Ponuda se prikazuje na stranici rezervacija klijenta 30 minuta, sa tačno tim vremenom. Ne drži mesto — ko prvi dođe, prvi je uslužen.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: Ljudi koji su tražili da budu obavešteni kad se dan oslobodi. Kad otkazivanje otvori termin, oni su prvi koje treba pozvati.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Klikni na dan da zakažeš slobodno vreme za tu osobu; klikni na postojeće odsustvo da ga ukloniš. Trake pokazuju koliko je radni dan već popunjen.

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Odsustvo uklanja sate te osobe iz kalendara, pa je nijedan klijent ne može zakazati dok je odsutna.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
translation: Nešto što salon treba da zna? (alergije, želje…)

english: No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Još nema klijenata — pojavljuju se ovde čim neko zakaže.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
translation: Ljudi se povezuju preko broja telefona kada su ga dali, pa isti klijent ostaje jedan zapis na telefonu, laptopu i recepciji. Privatne beleške su samo tvoje — klijenti ih nikad ne vide.

english: Shuts the whole shop — public holidays, renovation, the summer break. Nobody can be booked on these days, without touching anyone’s roster.
translation: Zatvara ceo salon — državni praznici, renoviranje, letnja pauza. Niko ne može biti zakazan tih dana, a nečiji raspored se ne dira.

english: The rest is cut into start times on the shop’s slot grid, and each candidate must fit the whole service plus the before/after buffers.
translation: Ostatak se seče na početna vremena prema mreži termina salona, a svaki kandidat mora da stane za celu uslugu plus pauze pre/posle.

english: At checkout the seat is held for 8 minutes and the database has the last word — a seat can only ever belong to one booking.
translation: Pri plaćanju mesto se drži 8 minuta, a baza podataka ima poslednju reč — mesto može pripadati samo jednoj rezervaciji.

english: {name} still has upcoming appointments — reassign or cancel them below first.
translation: {name} još ima predstojeće termine — prvo ih preraspodeli ili otkaži ispod.

english: Demo environment — bookings are simulated, no real payments.
translation: Demo okruženje — rezervacije su simulirane, bez stvarnih plaćanja.

english: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (required)
translation: Prihvatam Uslove korišćenja i Politiku privatnosti (obavezno)

english: Demo session — real OAuth activates once the provider is enabled in Supabase.
translation: Demo sesija — pravi OAuth se aktivira kad se provajder uključi u Supabase.

english: Almost there — confirm the link we just emailed you, then sign in.
translation: Skoro gotovo — potvrdi link koji smo ti upravo poslali mejlom, pa se prijavi.

english: Everything stored about you — GDPR Art. 20.
translation: Sve što je sačuvano o tebi — čl. 20 GDPR.

english: Really delete your account and profile? Bookings history in shops stays for legal retention.
translation: Zaista obrisati nalog i profil? Istorija rezervacija u salonima ostaje zbog zakonskog čuvanja.

english: This signs you out everywhere and removes your profile. It cannot be undone.
translation: Ovo te odjavljuje svuda i uklanja tvoj profil. Ne može se poništiti.

english: 🗑 Your profile, preferences and favourites are deleted.
translation: 🗑 Tvoj profil, podešavanja i omiljeni se brišu.

english: 🔒 Past receipts stay with the salons — German law requires them to keep invoices for the statutory retention period.
translation: 🔒 Prošli računi ostaju kod salona — nemački zakon ih obavezuje da čuvaju fakture u zakonskom roku.

english: 📅 Upcoming appointments are NOT cancelled. Cancel them first if you do not want to go.
translation: 📅 Predstojeći termini se NE otkazuju. Otkaži ih prvo ako ne želiš da ideš.

english: 📦 Download your data first — after this it is gone.
